description.en: DSH bundles published from github.com/bzsjn: whale balance widget plus (balance follows the active provider).
description.zh: 来自 github.com/bzsjn 的 DSH 插件：小鲸鱼余额挂件 plus（余额跟随当前使用的供应商）。

description.en: Same whale widget you know, but the number follows the provider you are actually using: reads agent-default-model, resolves the matching model entry, queries its balance endpoint (auto-detected for common relay shapes), forces CNY display, and hides the peak/off-peak rows that only apply to official DeepSeek pricing. Falls back to the original DeepSeek balance on any failure.
description.zh: 沿用原小鲸鱼挂件的全部功能，但余额数字跟随你实际在用的供应商：读取 agent-default-model、匹配模型条目、查询其余额接口（常见中转站形态自动探测）、强制按人民币显示，并在非官方供应商下隐藏只对 DeepSeek 官方计价有意义的峰谷行。任一步失败即回退原版 DeepSeek 余额。
